response.sql: WITH site_stats AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat, AVG(p.memusagegb) AS avg_ram, AVG(p.procgpu::numeric / NULLIF(p.proccpu, 0)) AS avg_gpu_cpu FROM scanprocessing p JOIN sites s ON p.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE p.memusagegb >= 60.8 GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat) SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_ram) AS avg_of_site_avg_ram, AVG(avg_gpu_cpu) AS avg_of_site_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM site_stats GROUP BY entrystat;
